title: Your Leads Into Zoho CRM: Enriched, Deduped, Followed Up, Reported

how_it_works: Your post left three blanks. Filled: UTM-tagged website forms, Apollo, Gmail then Twilio SMS.
Every lead gets Apollo's job title, company and website, then lands in Zoho CRM with each field mapped.
Zoho matches on email, then phone: a repeat form fill updates the lead and never restarts the follow-up.
New leads get Email 1 within a minute and a text the next day, unless Zoho already shows them contacted.
Room to add next: Meta instant forms, more touches, WhatsApp through the same Twilio node.
setup: Add hidden utm_source and utm_campaign fields to your forms and point them at this webhook.
Before go-live, set Authentication on the three Zoho nodes (3, 7, 11) to n8n's Zoho OAuth2 credential. The Config token is only for a first test, because a Zoho token expires in an hour.
Add Google Ads and Website to your Zoho Lead Source picklist.
Register your Twilio number for US business texting (A2P 10DLC) before the text goes live.
Set this workflow's Error Workflow to your n8n alert so a failed Zoho write reaches you.
need_from_you: Zoho CRM admin access, your edition, and any mandatory fields on your Lead layout.
Your Apollo API key, the Gmail inbox that sends Email 1, and your Twilio number.
Your booking link and the wording you want in Email 1 and the text.
Your lead volume per month and every source you run ads on.

sections.label: 1 - CAPTURE LEADS FROM YOUR ADS AND WEBSITE FORMS
sections.note: Your website and ad landing-page forms post every lead to one webhook, carrying the UTM tag your Google and Facebook ads add. That tag becomes the lead's source in Zoho. A form that drops the tag files the lead as Website, and your by-source report goes flat.

sections.label: 2 - ENRICH EACH LEAD THROUGH APOLLO
sections.note: Apollo looks the lead up by work email and adds job title, company, website and location. No match, and the lead carries on without them.

sections.label: 3 - ROUTE INTO ZOHO CRM: FIELD MAPPING AND DEDUP
sections.note: Every field maps to your Zoho CRM lead layout, and Zoho checks email, then phone, before it writes. New leads are created; returning ones are updated and skip the follow-up.

sections.label: 4 - FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE: EMAIL NOW, TEXT NEXT DAY
sections.note: Email 1 goes from your Gmail within a minute, BCC'd to Zoho so it shows on the lead. The next day a text goes out, only if Zoho still shows them not contacted.

sections.label: 5 - REPORT: LEAD VOLUME AND CONVERSION BY SOURCE
sections.note: Every Monday your Lead Dashboard tab refreshes from Zoho: leads, converted leads and conversion rate per source for the last 30 days.

nodes.label: 3 - Zoho CRM: Match by Email or Phone, Then Create or Update
nodes.notes: One person from two ads stays one Zoho lead: email is checked first, then phone.

params.body:
{{ JSON.stringify({
  data: [{
    First_Name: $('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.first_name,
    Last_Name: $('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.last_name || 'Not given',
    Email: $('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.email,
    Phone: $('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.phone || undefined,
    Company: $('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.company || $json.person?.organization?.name || 'Not given',
    Designation: $json.person?.title || undefined,
    Website: $json.person?.organization?.website_url || undefined,
    City: $json.person?.city || undefined,
    State: $json.person?.state || undefined,
    Lead_Source: { google: 'Google Ads', facebook: 'Facebook', instagram: 'Facebook' }[($('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.utm_source || '').toLowerCase()] || 'Website',
    Description: 'Inquiry: ' + ($('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.message || 'none') + '\nAd campaign: ' + ($('1 - New Lead From Your Ads or Website Form').item.json.body.utm_campaign || 'none')
  }],
  duplicate_check_fields: ['Email', 'Phone'],
  trigger: ['workflow']
}) }}
